lever: Qwen3-8B ROM TP4 asynchronous collective: fused post-TP epilogue + cut-through all-reduce (ASYNC_COLL=1, descriptor bit 20), ot_qwen_tp_seq_async_w12
reason: cannot close physically: in-context SS setup at 1.2 GHz is -546 ps (548 endpoints, scoreboard seq.lw[*]; vw -> 24-bit subtract/range compare -> one-hot decode -> 48-port OR tree, ~1.3 ns logic depth); the same flow closes ASYNC_COLL=0 (+17.1 ps SS, +6.2 ps FF hold). Owner rule: no rescue loop.
